title: Account Executive
description:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik's sales organisation is a unified group of elite cross functional professionals helping companies across every major industry, from financial services and manufacturing to the public sector, achieve true resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. As an Enterprise Account Executive in France, you will drive Rubrik's expansion in one of Europe's most dynamic enterprise markets, owning the full sales cycle from first contact to close and building the pipeline that powers our growth across the French enterprise landscape.


What You'll Do

  • Define and execute a territory sales plan for France, driving net new logo acquisition through disciplined prospecting, pipeline development, and strategic account pursuit
  • Run complete, multistakeholder sales cycles end to end, from discovery and qualification through solution design, negotiation, and close, consistently building toward and exceeding your targets
  • Build and manage a high quality pipeline that balances breadth across your enterprise territory with depth in your highest priority opportunities
  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development, and Rubrik's partner ecosystem to position our data security platform against the full scope of customer risk
  • Develop relationships with key decision makers and executive sponsors within target accounts, connecting Rubrik's capabilities to their most pressing business priorities
  • Work with channel partners, distributors, and VARs to extend your reach and accelerate growth across the territory

title: Senior Director FP&A
description:
The Role

At euNetworks, Finance plays a critical role in supporting strategic decision-making, driving commercial performance and enabling sustainable business growth. As a leading European provider of high-capacity fibre network infrastructure and Data Centre to Data Centre connectivity, euNetworks operates in a dynamic, investment-intensive market where robust financial planning and analysis are essential.

euNetworks is seeking a commercially-minded Senior Director of Financial Planning & Analysis to lead financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and business partnering across the business. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this role will take ownership of monthly financial reporting and deliver high-quality financial insights to the Board and ExCo to shape strategy and drive performance.

Working closely with commercial and operational stakeholders, the Senior Director will act as a trusted business partner, translating financial data into actionable insights that support revenue growth, cost management and investment decisions. The role will also work closely with Business Operations to strengthen commercial performance analysis, forecasting and alignment between financial plans and sales objectives.

This is an opportunity for an experienced finance leader with a strong commercial finance background to influence business strategy and drive financial performance across a growing European digital infrastructure business.

What will you be doing?

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Lead the FP&A function, overseeing financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis across the business.
  • Lead, develop and motivate a high-performing FP&A team, setting clear objectives and building the capability needed to support the business's growth.

title: Technical Data Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

A Technical Data Analyst is responsible for performing data migration, data conversion and data validation projects for Addepar clients using existing tools and established processes. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of financial portfolio data, a foundational level of python programming skills, exceptional communication skills and the ability to deliver results in alignment with project deadlines while meeting high quality standards.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Convert, migrate and validate data from external or internal sources using existing tooling with defined processes and workflows
